context: Items not gating §5 acceptance per GOAL contract. Bundled here for V1.0.2 backlog tracking. Each carries a clear scope, anchor, and recommendation.

items.title: Driver notification listeners lack idempotency on queue retry
items.scope: If queue worker retries a SendOrderDeliveryBoy* event (e.g. transient SMTP/SMS gateway failure), the listener fires again and the driver receives a duplicate notification.
items.recommendation: Add a dedup table (webhook_events-style) keyed on (order_id, status, channel) OR adopt Cache::lock around the send() call with a 5-minute TTL. Pattern: see app/Models/WebhookEvent.php + IdempotencyKeyMiddleware. ETA V1.0.2: 1 day.

items.title: Generic 422 controllers leak raw $exception->getMessage()
items.scope: User-facing error strings may leak SQL/DB exception fragments. Codebase-wide pattern; not unique to Livreur.
items.recommendation: V1.0.2 polish wave: replace with `trans('all.message.generic_error')` + Log::error for ops. Wait until cross-cutting fix lands. ETA V1.0.2: 0.5 day per controller.

items.title: Frontend driver routes have no role:Delivery Boy guard
items.scope: Any authenticated sanctum user can hit /api/frontend/delivery-boy-order/* endpoints. Service-level ownership checks (deliveryBoyOrderDetails:1428-1444) provide last-line defense, but defense-in-depth wants a role guard.
items.recommendation: Add `role:Delivery Boy,sanctum` middleware to the prefix group. Verify role exists in seeder. ETA V1.0.2: 0.5 day.

items.title: No throttle on driver status-change endpoint
items.scope: POST /api/frontend/delivery-boy-order/change-status/{order} can be hit at full throughput. While ValidStatusTransition + lockForUpdate provide logical bound, no per-IP rate limit.
items.recommendation: Add `throttle:60,1` (60 req/min). Pattern: see routes/api.php Wave 3 P1 throttle additions. ETA V1.0.2: 0.5 day.

items.title: Driver status-change endpoint missing idempotency key support
items.scope: X-Idempotency-Key header not honoured. Service has logical idempotent early-return for same-status (OrderService:1540) but a fast double-tap across distinct states races past.
items.recommendation: Add `idempotency` middleware to the route. Pattern: routes/api.php:880 (select-delivery-boy already has it). ETA V1.0.2: 0.5 day.

items.title: Missing composite index on orders(delivery_boy_id, branch_id, status, created_at)
items.scope: OrderService::deliveryBoyOrder + deliveryBoyOrderCount filter on three columns. Single-column index on delivery_boy_id (if any) not optimal for high volume.
items.recommendation: Add migration with composite covering index. ETA V1.0.2: 0.5 day. Measure pre/post EXPLAIN.

items.title: deliveryBoyOrderCount runs two near-identical COUNT queries
items.scope: Two separate WHERE+COUNT queries (DELIVERED, RETURNED). Could be a single SELECT status, COUNT(*) GROUP BY status WHERE status IN (...).

items.title: E2E spec uses fixed 1500ms waitForTimeout — flaky on slow CI
items.scope: Codebase-wide flaky pattern. Switch to waitForLoadState('networkidle') or semantic selector wait.
items.recommendation: V1.0.2 test cleanup wave. ETA V1.0.2: 0.5 day per spec.

items.title: Hardcoded FR delivery-minimum error string with € symbol
items.recommendation: V1.0.2 i18n wave. ETA V1.0.2: 0.5 day.
